tooling_used: Claude in Chrome browser connector (navigation attempt)
tooling_constraints: No general-purpose outbound network access is available from the code-execution sandbox in this session (its allow-list covers package registries such as npm/PyPI/GitHub only, not arbitrary websites), so no automated Node/Python crawler (Playwright, Cheerio, etc.) could actually run against the live site.

The web_fetch tool only accepts URLs that were themselves returned by a prior web_search result or supplied directly by the user; URLs merely present as link text inside an already-fetched page are rejected. This blocked link-following from the homepage.

web_search / web_search_fast returned no indexed results for tajlandia.com beyond generic queries; the site's internal pages (/oferty, /lokalizacje, /blog, district and article pages, robots.txt, sitemap.xml) do not appear to be indexed by the available search backend.

The Claude in Chrome browser connector was loaded and a tab was created, but every navigation attempt to https://tajlandia.com/ returned 'Permission denied by user', across three different connected browser instances and after the user attempted to grant site access. The root cause could not be resolved within this session.

buying_process.section_title_en: How a Foreigner Buys Property in Thailand

steps.title: Purpose and Budget
steps.description: You determine whether you are buying for rental income, personal stay, or resale - this determines the location, property type, and ownership structure.

steps.title: Ownership Structure
steps.description: A foreigner can buy a condo under full ownership (freehold, within the building's 49% foreign quota) or enter into a registered 30-year leasehold - typical for villas and houses.

steps.title: Reservation and Due Diligence
steps.description: After the reservation agreement, the land's legal title (chanote), building permits, and the developer's standing are verified - before you sign the main contract.

steps.title: Contract and Payments from Abroad
steps.description: Purchase funds are transferred from abroad in foreign currency; the bank issues a Foreign Exchange Transaction (FET) confirmation, required when registering ownership for a foreigner.

steps.title: Ownership Transfer and Handover
steps.description: Ownership is registered at the local Land Office. After the technical handover, you decide on a rental management model - self-managed or through an operator.
